title: Parts Warranty on Readjustments — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Parts warranty on a readjustment.** Under Alignment Services & Plans the parts warranty sets the parts amount of a readjustment, by the work order of the corrected alignment — whether that work order installed parts (a parts charge above 0.00), and the whole calendar months and miles that separate it from the readjustment. The parts warranty is 12 months and 12000 miles on every line.

| Corrected alignment's work order installed parts | Whole calendar months between it and the readjustment | Miles between them | Listed parts on the readjustment are |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | fewer than 12 | no more than 2000 | replaced free (parts amount 0.00) |
| Yes | fewer than 12 | more than 2000 but no more than 12000 | prorated: the parts amount is the listed price multiplied by the miles run since the corrected alignment, divided by 12000 |
| every other case | | | charged at the listed price |

### Worked cases (hypothetical; listed parts 80.00, corrected work order with parts)
- 4 months, 1500 miles → free: 0.00.
- 4 months, 3000 miles → 80.00 multiplied by 3000, divided by 12000: 20.00.
- 4 months, 12001 miles → listed price: 80.00.
- 12 months, 1000 miles → not fewer than 12 months: listed price 80.00.
- corrected work order installed no parts → listed price 80.00.
